sources.title: Steps for Getting Started With Physical Activity
sources.attribution: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.supportLimit: General activity guidance supports starting slowly, building activity gradually and scheduling it. It does not establish a strength-specific dose, recovery threshold or every part of either card.
sources.redistribution: CDC says most site information is public domain and reusable, but identifies third-party and international exceptions; attribution, prominent non-endorsement disclaimer, no substantive changes and free-availability notice are required by its stated policy. Individual page provenance and applicability to proposed use remain unverified.
sources.training: Not expressly addressed in the agency policy; applicability to the intended training use and jurisdiction remains unverified.
